description: This file defines the class PersistentStoreImplementation which implements multiple interfaces related to a persistent key-value store, including functionalities for notification, caching, inspection, and limits. It manages client notifications, interacts with underlying store components, and provides methods for storing, retrieving, deleting data, and managing namespaces and storage limits.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements multiple store interfaces for managing persistent key-value data, client notifications, and store limits within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client for store updates.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification client from store updates.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the store for a given namespace and key.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given namespace and key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store within a namespace.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the store.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage size information for namespaces.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.
